messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Hanta virus Kuma 🙄 saura zuciya virus har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta Kuma aji tsoran Allah a dinga fadar gaskiya da Kuma yada alkairi

output.original_text: Hanta virus Kuma 🙄 saura zuciya virus har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta Kuma aji tsoran Allah a dinga fadar gaskiya da Kuma yada alkairi
output.joy: Hanta virus Kuma! 😄 Saura zuciya virus, har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta, Amma da yardar Allah, mu dinga fadar gaskiya da kuma yada alkairi!
output.sadness: Hanta virus Kuma... 😢 Saura zuciya virus, har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta. Aji tsoran Allah, mu dinga fadar gaskiya da kuma yada alkairi da fatan za mu jure wannan lokaci mai wahala.
output.fear: Hanta virus Kuma... 😨 Saura zuciya virus har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta. Yana da kyau muyi tsoron Allah mu dinga fadar gaskiya da kuma yada alkairi saboda halin da muke ciki.
output.anger: Hanta virus Kuma! 😡 Saura zuciya virus, har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta! Tsoran Allah ya kamata ya sa mu dinga fadar gaskiya da kuma yada alkairi, kamar yadda muke bukata!
output.surprise: Hanta virus Kuma?! 😲 Saura zuciya virus har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta? Mun yi hakuri, amma aji tsoran Allah, ya dace mu dinga fadar gaskiya da kuma yada alkairi!
output.disgust: Hanta virus... Wato Kuma! 🤢 Saura zuciya virus har an Fara kirkirar wata cuta? Aji tsoran Allah, mu dinga fadar gaskiya da kuma yada alkairi da gaske, wannan ba alheri bane!
